description: This file is a markdown documentation page for the 'ElementHandle' class in the Playwright API. It includes detailed descriptions, usage examples in multiple programming languages, and method signatures related to the 'ElementHandle' class, which is used for in-page DOM element interactions.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents an in-page DOM element handle that can be used to interact with, inspect, and perform actions on DOM elements within a page.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the element, or null if the element is not visible. It provides coordinates and size details, useful for input or precise interactions.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or radio input element, performing necessary checks and actions to ensure the element becomes checked.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks the element by moving the mouse and performing a click action, with options for button, click count, delay, position, etc.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Returns the content frame if the element is an iframe, or null otherwise.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double clicks the element, dispatching two click events and one double click event.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event of specified type on the element, optionally using event initialization properties.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Finds an element matching the selector within the element's subtree and executes a script in its context.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Finds all matching elements within the subtree and executes a script, returning the result.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills a text input or contenteditable element with the specified value.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Calls the focus() method on the element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Returns the value of a specified attribute on the element.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element, moving the mouse to its center.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Returns the innerHTML of the element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Returns the innerText of the element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Returns the current value of an input, textarea, or select element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Returns whether the checkbox or radio input is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Returns whether the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Returns whether the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Returns whether the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Returns whether the element is visible.

methods.name: ownerFrame
methods.description: Returns the frame that contains this element, if any.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key while the element is focused.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Finds a single element matching the selector within the element's subtree.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Finds all elements matching the selector within the element's subtree.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Captures a screenshot of the element.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if it is not already visible.

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a `<select>` element.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects all text content within the element.

methods.name: setChecked
methods.description: Checks or unchecks a checkbox or radio input.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets the value of a file input element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Simulates a tap gesture on the element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Returns the textContent of the node.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element by focusing and sending keyboard events.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox or radio input.

methods.name: waitForElementState
methods.description: Waits for the element to meet a certain state (visible, hidden, enabled, etc.).

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for a selector to satisfy a specified state within the subtree of the element handle.
